properties.displayName: UAV S19 - SOC Alert Capacity Threshold Exceeded
properties.description: UAVSocLoad_CL의 10분 윈도우 알림 처리량(AlertCountPerWindow)이 UAV_Threshold_List의 MaxSocAlertPerWindow(동시 처리 가능 임계)를 초과하면 SOC 용량 초과(알림 폭주로 인한 탐지 사각 발생 위험)로 탐지. 임계값은 Watchlist로 동적 산출(고정값 아님). MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0814(Denial of Service — 방어 체계 자체를 알림 폭주로 무력화하는 가용성 공격 계열, Enterprise 근접기법 T1499로 매핑)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let capacityThreshold = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List') | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxSocAlertPerWindow' | project toint(Value) | take 1);
UAVSocLoad_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| summarize AlertCountPerWindow = sum(AlertCount), AnalystsOnDuty = max(AnalystsOnDuty), QueueDepth = max(QueueDepth) by SocId, TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, alertWindow)
| extend CapacityThreshold = capacityThreshold
| extend Exceeded = AlertCountPerWindow > CapacityThreshold
| where Exceeded
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('SOC_알림처리한계_초과_', SocId, '_', tostring(AlertCountPerWindow), '/', tostring(capacityThreshold))
| extend Severity = iff(AlertCountPerWindow > capacityThreshold * 2, 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated = TimeBin, SocId, AlertCountPerWindow, CapacityThreshold, Exceeded, QueueDepth, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S19 - SOC Alert Capacity Threshold Exceeded - {{SocId}}
